issues.detail: The skill is specific to Node.js and amqplib, not platform-agnostic.

scenarios.name: publish-order-confirmation
scenarios.rationale: Response A meets all rubric requirements, while Response B omits the confirm channel, confirms, and backpressure handling.

scenarios.name: consume-with-dead-letter
scenarios.rationale: Response B correctly implements redelivery‑based nack logic and uses nack, but both miss the required x-message-ttl argument; A uses a header retry scheme and reject instead of nack, making it less compliant.

scenarios.name: auto-reconnect
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully satisfies the rubric, while Response A does not meet any of the required elements.
